name: swiftui-expert-dev
title: SwiftUI expert
description: Apply focused SwiftUI and Swift concurrency expertise for state, composition, navigation, performance, accessibility, and testability.
notes:
## What it does

This is a narrow reusable implementation capability for native iOS work. It helps an owner skill choose safe state ownership, value-driven navigation, structured concurrency, efficient composition, accessible controls, and deterministic tests.

## Boundary

It does not own product intent, cross-platform visual direction, API authorization, or build/simulator orchestration. Hand those questions to ios-product-dev, design-frontend-dev, and xcodebuildmcp-cli respectively.

changes: Add a portable focused SwiftUI implementation capability for Agents and Claude.

commands.name: Refactor SwiftUI state
commands.desc: Choose stable ownership, identity, navigation, and cancellation boundaries without changing product behavior.

commands.name: Harden a SwiftUI surface
commands.desc: Cover accessibility, loading/error/empty states, Dynamic Type, reduced motion, and testable interactions.

commands.name: Diagnose SwiftUI performance
commands.desc: Find unnecessary invalidation, unstable identity, expensive body work, or unstructured async tasks and propose measured fixes.
